pool.sol: Injective means distinct inputs never share an output; equivalently \(f(a_1)=f(a_2)\Rightarrow a_1=a_2\).

pool.text: A function \(f:A\to B\) is onto (surjective) means:
pool.sol: Surjective means the range equals the codomain: every element of \(B\) is hit.
